name: Sole Parent Support
description: Sole Parent Support is a main benefit providing financial assistance to sole parents caring for dependent children.

attributes.summary: A comprehensive main benefit for sole parents, detailing eligibility criteria, obligations, sanctions, payment rules, and change-of-circumstances processes administered by Work and Income.
attributes.eligibility: Sole parents with dependent children under 14 years of age
attributes.payment_details: Main benefit rates and payment rules as per main-benefits-rates and main-benefits-cut-out-points policies
attributes.obligations: Work obligations, work preparation obligations, social obligations, drug test obligations, work with contracted service provider obligation, work ability assessment obligation
attributes.stand_down: Initial stand-down period applies; 13-week non-entitlement period as sanction
attributes.income_test: Income abatement thresholds apply as per main-benefits-income-abatement-thresholds policy
